description: Triages the 121 UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW execution sites surfaced by the parallel execution audit. Adds 38 path-rules across 56 top-level scripts/ helpers, introduces a NEEDS_OWNER_DECISION classification token, and adds a safety-by-default kind-aware override that flags shell=True / os.system / os.popen as BLOCKED_UNSAFE regardless of path (with PROGRAMBENCH_OUT_OF_SCOPE and LEGACY_EXEMPT_TEST_FIXTURE carve-outs). Drops UNKNOWN from 121 to 0; surfaces 2 real BLOCKED_UNSAFE sites in scripts/verified_task/command_runner.py (shell=True with user-supplied command strings) and 1 MUST_MIGRATE site in scripts/determinex_codeclash_agent.py.
purpose: Rung 8 of the post-audit Claude-lane sequence. Per directive: 'before routing models or allowing broader repair orchestration, Claude needs to know which helper scripts are harmless read-only orchestration, which are already sandboxed, which belong to Codex, and which must migrate.' This rung closes that triage gap. Migration of the 1 MUST_MIGRATE site and the 1 BLOCKED_UNSAFE file is the next rung's scope; this rung is classification only.

new_classification_token.purpose: Reserved for genuinely ambiguous sites that a future sweep cannot decide without Ryan's explicit ownership call. Currently 0 sites; no helper in the 121-site UNKNOWN bucket needed it.

kind_aware_override.rule: If a detected site's kind is in this set, it is unconditionally classified BLOCKED_UNSAFE regardless of the file's path-rule. The path-rule's rationale is preserved in the site's rationale.
kind_aware_override.carve_outs_rationale: PROGRAMBENCH is Codex's responsibility — Claude does not seal Codex's shell=True sites. LEGACY_EXEMPT_TEST_FIXTURE preserves test scaffolding that may legitimately use shell semantics.
kind_aware_override.verified_carve_out_in_action: scripts/pb_factory_worker_loop.py:953 contains shell=True but stays PROGRAMBENCH_OUT_OF_SCOPE, not BLOCKED_UNSAFE.

blocked_unsafe_sites_surfaced.rationale: CommandRunner.run takes `command: str` and calls subprocess.run with shell=True — classic shell injection surface. Path-rule explicitly flags this file BLOCKED_UNSAFE.
Kind-aware override unconditionally flags shell=True (path-rule already agreed via the BLOCKED_UNSAFE classification above).

must_migrate_sites_surfaced.rationale: CodeClash arena agent invokes py_compile on user-controlled codebase files via raw subprocess.run; same pattern ShadowCompiler had pre-rung-5. Should route through intake.hardened_runner with workspace bounding.

The single MUST_MIGRATE site is in scripts/determinex_codeclash_agent.py (line 285).
PB shell=True site at scripts/pb_factory_worker_loop.py:953 stays PROGRAMBENCH_OUT_OF_SCOPE (kind-override correctly carves out PB).
The kind-aware override fires for verified_task/command_runner.py's shell=True (correctly escalates to BLOCKED_UNSAFE).
NEEDS_OWNER_DECISION exists in CLASSIFICATIONS and STATUS_TOKENS, currently has 0 sites (reserved for future genuinely-ambiguous cases).
The audit is still read-only (no subprocess called during a scan — monkeypatch sentinel verified).
Signed evidence is unmutated by a scan.
38 path-rules cover all 56 previously-UNKNOWN helper files.
